sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 210. Success value 100. 3x magic damage (Light).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes debuffs.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 40% for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 40 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 25.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rage for 60 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 8000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 8000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies resurrection.
Only [Acedia Temptress] Sinful Bride Belvia can be used as Unlocking Potential material
